_comment: Pack EN 6, six options for each message: 1 is the default (the wav text, corrected), 2 and 3 professional variants, 4 to 6 more and more colloquial. Futile messages (futile true) have two silent options first: 1 and 2 empty, 3 the default, 4 to 6 the others. Corrections of the spreadsheet texts are in the default option.
